claims: Michael B. Jordan won the 2026 Oscar for Best Actor for his dual role as twins Smoke and Stack in Sinners.
Sinners follows twin brothers battling supernatural forces in the 1930s Mississippi Delta.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for his performance in Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan played identical twins Elijah "Smoke" Moore and Elias "Stack" Moore in Sinners.
Elijah "Smoke" Moore and Elias "Stack" Moore return to their Southern home to start a new life before confronting an evil force in Sinners.
Sinners is written and directed by Ryan Coogler.
Sinners marks another collaboration between Michael B. Jordan and Ryan Coogler, as noted by Variety.
Sinners is a horror/thriller movie featuring vampires in the Jim Crow South.
Smoke is portrayed as a grumpy, stoic, and scarred character in Sinners.
Stack is portrayed as more outgoing and charming in Sinners.
Sinners was released in theaters in April 2025.
